title: improve_result — backlog improve's improved task (task 10)
description: The backlog improve agent's output (docs/stage-io, task 10). The `ready` task is FLAT (task_title, task_body, ...) because a local quantised model corrupted a nested `task` object in its tool call (run 01M3SFYASZQ7MEKVKR1A38C4J0); improve_gate assembles current_task.json from those fields and defaults id, files, covers and priority from the current task. `split` keeps a nested `tasks` array. improve_gate checks the disposition enum and the per-disposition shape; the split/queue logic and per-run budget stay in the gate. `reason` is always written for the human record. _io is stamped by the server.

reason.description: One or two sentences justifying the disposition.

task_id.description: Ignored when the current task has an id; the gate keeps that id byte-for-byte.
